svg.title: Northern Ireland municipal waste routes 2024/25
svg.desc: Of the municipal waste collected by Northern Ireland councils in 2024/25, 50.4% was recycled or composted, 34.3% went to energy recovery and 14.0% to landfill (DAERA, 11 December 2025). The Climate Change Act (Northern Ireland) 2022 requires at least 70% of waste to be recycled by 2030. Recycling has been flat at about 50%; landfill fell but energy recovery took its place, so waste moved down the hierarchy rather than up.
svg.text: Northern Ireland: where council-collected waste went, 2024/25
Per cent of local-authority collected municipal waste. DAERA, released 11 December 2025.
Recycling has been flat at about 50% for years. Landfill fell, but energy recovery took its place: waste moved
down the hierarchy, not up. The 70% target (Climate Change Act (NI) 2022, s.18) still needs defining, says DAERA.
